name: Get samples by hash
description: Look up SHA256/SHA1/MD5 hashes in VMRay's existing analyses and return every matching sample — costs no quota.

hashes.description: SHA256, SHA1 or MD5 hashes to look up. Duplicates are ignored. Costs no quota.
hashes.title: Hashes

samples.description: The matched sample objects as VMRay returns them from the lookup (verdict, score, hashes, threat names, classifications, report link) — no VTIs/IOCs/MITRE ATT&CK, those need a separate fetch.
samples.title: Samples

errors.description: Per-hash failures (invalid hash or lookup error).
errors.title: Errors
